# pushsecurity_apps (Data Source)

Lists the apps in the tenant, so that app-scoped control criteria can be written against what actually exists.

The API's app endpoint filters only on creation time, so filtering here happens in the provider after fetching every app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pushsecurity_apps" "all" {}

# Apps carrying a particular label. The API's app endpoint filters only on
# creation time, so this filtering happens in the provider.
data "pushsecurity_apps" "unreviewed_ai" {
  labels            = ["ai"]
  approval_statuses = ["NOT_REVIEWED", "UNDER_REVIEW"]
}

# Useful for discovering what a tenant actually uses before writing criteria.
output "app_types" {
  value = data.pushsecurity_apps.all.types
}

output "labels_in_use" {
  value = data.pushsecurity_apps.all.all_labels
}

# The types are ready to pass to an app_types criterion, in a rule of a control
# you have already imported:
#
#   criteria = {
#     app_types = { matches = data.pushsecurity_apps.unreviewed_ai.types }
#   }
#
# Import the control before you add it to your configuration. A control
# resource owns the whole control, so applying one you have not imported
# replaces every rule the tenant already has.
output "unreviewed_ai_types" {
  value = data.pushsecurity_apps.unreviewed_ai.types
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `approval_statuses` (Set of String) Only return apps with any of these approval statuses.
- `labels` (Set of String) Only return apps carrying any of these labels.

### Read-Only

- `all_labels` (Set of String) Every label seen across the matching apps — useful for discovering what labels a tenant uses.
- `apps` (Attributes List) The matching apps, ordered by type, and by identifier among apps of the same type, so the result is stable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))
- `types` (Set of String) Just the app types, ready to pass to an `app_types` criterion.

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `approval_status` (String) The app's approval status, as used by the `approval_statuses` criterion. Empty when the app has not been reviewed.
- `category_codes` (Set of String) The app's category codes, as used by the `app_categories` criterion. Strings, because that is what the criterion matches on.
- `category_names` (Set of String) The human-readable names of the app's categories.
- `friendly_name` (String) The app's display name.
- `id` (String) The app's identifier.
- `labels` (Set of String) The labels applied to the app, as used by the `app_labels` criterion.
- `sensitivity_level` (String) The app's sensitivity level, as used by the `sensitivity_levels` criterion. Empty when it has not been set.
- `type` (String) The app's type, as used by the `app_types` criterion.
- `website` (String) The app's website.
